summary.value: New York Marriott Marquis is the large Marriott hotel on Times Square, with the Marquis Theatre in the building and Broadway houses all around. It suits first-timers and theater fans who want to be in the middle of it all, and Trip.com guests rate it 8.9 / 10 Very good 655 reviews, saying “The hotel has a fantastic location and the rooms are very clean”. Honest watch-outs: it can get a bit noisy at night, and the hotel charges a mandatory $40 daily fee.

description.value: New York Marriott Marquis is a Marriott hotel on Times Square in the Theater District. It is one of the largest hotels in the city, with the Marquis Theatre inside the building. Broadway theaters, the TKTS booth and Bryant Park are all within a short walk. Trip.com shows 8.9 / 10 Very good 655 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The hotel has a fantastic location and the rooms are very clean”. Representative watch-outs: “it can get a bit noisy at night”; “the hotel charges a mandatory $40 daily fee”.
